safe_wording: Boundary-forced routing recovers the MPPT/pitch partition under strict-cache WTB replay, intervention, placebo, threshold-validity, and within-WTB spatial/future stress tests.
Gate-aware reserve can reduce boundary-window shortage and violation in selected operating slices; it is not a universal reserve policy.
Gate-correct but forecast-bad cases are explicitly reported to separate mechanism responsibility from value accuracy.
Late WTB slices preserve routing semantics but show large RMSE degradation under distribution shift.
The completed external runs fail the site-transfer criterion and are reported as boundary-condition diagnostics requiring local re-estimation.
Graph WaveNet and lag-feature engineering baselines remain stronger WTB forecasters on RMSE.
